research.name: Interdisciplinary Institute of Political Economy (IIEP - UBA - CONICET)
research.summary:
Currently assisting in projects leveraging unstructured text data and Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract inflation expectations.
Recently assisted in gathering information for the fine-tuning process of the LLM, which then is transformed into a quantitative indicator through Natural Language Inference (NLI).
Work under the coordination of José Daniel Aromí (Ph.D., University of Maryland).

projects.name: BCRA_bot
projects.summary:
I developed a Twitter bot (@BCRA_bot) that tweets daily updates of Argentina's monetary statistics, together with weekly and monthly analyses. Data is gathered using the Central Bank of Argentina (BCRA)'s official API.
The bot is hosted in Google Cloud Platform, and run with Google Cloud Scheduler.

Due to Twitter's policy changes regarding bots, it may sporadically go offline.
